headline: Argentina Real Public Spending Drops 5.4% in October Amid Fiscal Drive
summary: Argentina's public spending fell 5.4% in real terms in October, extending an accumulated 3.2% decline in 2026. The reduction was concentrated heavily on transfers to provinces.
why: Argentina is undergoing a strict fiscal consolidation program to eliminate deficits and stabilize the macroeconomic environment.

impacts.name: S&P Merval
impacts.why: Spending cuts highlight continued fiscal contraction that directly shapes Argentine sovereign debt and domestic equities.
